capability_staircase: named-part richness relative to frozen spec instances
paper_alignment.semantic_validation: three independent judges over exported GLB mesh-node names, node previews, and frozen reference roles

units.part: mesh-bearing node in the frozen converted GLB; empty hierarchy/group nodes are excluded
units.named_part: GLB mesh node whose name is not a generic placeholder
units.spec_part: one required role instance after expanding min_count
units.repeated_instance: required role with min_count greater than one

formulas.strong_match_sensitivity: assignments whose canonical role tokens occur in the link name or whose actually matched pattern has at least two tokens / required spec instances
formulas.instance_discriminability: sum(min(distinct_instance_keys, required_count)) / sum(required_count) over repeated roles
formulas.semantic_precision: three-judge consensus real named parts / judged named parts
formulas.semantic_recall: three-judge consensus matched spec instances / required spec instances
formulas.judge_functional_core_coverage: three-judge consensus matched functional instances / required functional instances
formulas.judge_instance_discriminability: sum(min(distinct consensus instance IDs, required count)) / sum(required count) over repeated roles
formulas.over_segmentation_rate_micro: same-part consensus component excess fragments / three-judge consensus real mesh nodes

matching.algorithm: maximum-cardinality, maximum-specificity bipartite assignment between named links and expanded required role instances
matching.specificity: score only patterns actually matched by the link; longer token patterns outrank generic aliases
matching.equal_score_link_tie_breaker: lexicographic link/node name; independent of URDF XML or glTF node order
matching.unmatched_named_links: extra-real-part candidates sent to judges, never automatic false positives
matching.confidence_audit: report exact/specific matches, single-token aliases, runner-up margins, and a conservative strong-match sensitivity score

cross_seed_aggregation.pair_micro: mean over all within-cohort seed pairs; cohorts with more seeds receive more weight
cross_seed_aggregation.cohort_macro: mean of each cohort's pairwise mean; every cohort receives equal weight
cross_seed_aggregation.primary_reporting: report both pair-micro and cohort-macro, plus cohort median and bootstrap CI

judge_contract.consensus: at least two identical non-uncertain verdicts
judge_contract.missing_consensus: exclude from precision numerator and report coverage; do not force a verdict
judge_contract.instance_id: for a spec_match role with min_count>1, record the instance identity distinguishable from node name and preview; same-instance fragments share an ID; otherwise use not_applicable
judge_contract.same_semantic_part_as: for each real node, explicitly use none or another node name in the same asset; invalid uses not_applicable; null means unannotated, never no-duplicate
judge_contract.metric_readiness: a formal metric is emitted only when verdict consensus and every additional field required by that metric are complete

limitations: N=33 Parts/Named were independently recomputed from converted GLB mesh nodes; local visual-to-link merge policy may still differ from the paper's unreleased converter.
The frozen role references are copied authoring/spec evidence, not independent hidden annotations.
Paper-equivalent semantic precision and recall remain unavailable until three independent judge files are completed.
Cross-seed consistency and over-segmentation are local extensions, not metrics reported in the paper's Naming table.
